steps.label: Log group
steps.sub: one per application or service, e.g. /ecs/northbridge-checkout

steps.label: Log stream
steps.sub: one per source instance or task within that group

steps.label: awslogs driver / Container Insights
steps.sub: ships stdout/stderr in, no app code required

caption: fields selects, filter narrows, sort orders, limit caps the result
code:
fields @timestamp, @message, durationMs, statusCode
| filter @logStream like /checkout/
| filter durationMs > 2000
| sort durationMs desc
| limit 20

caption: stats ... by bin(5m) — the same shape as KQL's summarize ... by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
code:
fields @timestamp, durationMs
| filter @logStream like /checkout/
| stats avg(durationMs) as avgDuration,
        count() as requestCount
    by bin(5m)

subtitle: Following one request across every service it touched
